clips.title: The story
paras: At Westbrook Garrison, Painted Gnoll Armbands prove that Riverpaw gnolls have been slain. The marked bands come from packs pressing against Elwynn Forest's western border.

Riverpaw warriors and scavengers wear rough armbands painted with crude tribal patterns. The bands come from gnolls along Elwynn Forest's wilderness borders. For Stormwind's defenders, the packs pose a growing threat near Stone Cairn Lake and in the woods south of Westbrook Garrison.

Stormwind's Army is stretched thin across the kingdom, leaving Westbrook Garrison hard pressed to secure the western border. Deputy Rainer offers a standing bounty for slaying Riverpaw outrunners and runts. Their painted armbands prove the kills, helping the deputies count the bounties and thin the packs near nearby farmlands.
